description: This file defines the class 'SavingsProductAccountingDataValidator' which performs validation logic for savings product accounting data in a financial software system. It includes methods to evaluate accounting data, validate payment channel mappings, and charge-to-income account mappings, using helper classes and validation rules.

classes.name: SavingsProductAccountingDataValidator
classes.description: Validator class responsible for validating savings product accounting data, including account IDs and mappings, ensuring data integrity before processing or storage.

methods.name: evaluateProductAccountingData
methods.description: Performs validation of the provided JSON accounting data, checking for required account IDs based on rules and account types.

methods.name: validatePaymentChannelFundSourceMappings
methods.description: Validates the mappings between payment channels and funding sources as specified in the JSON data.

methods.name: validateChargeToIncomeAccountMappings
methods.description: Validates charge-to-income account mappings for both fees and penalties in the JSON data.
